summary: Iter 29: Validated (A) admin confirmation email (Resend), (B) Yaadein 'coming soon' series, (C) gallery desc sort. Backend pytest 11/11 passed (1 skipped analytics endpoint variant). Frontend verified: 4 Yaadein cards render with WIP button (no price/venue/reserve), WIP modal shows tag+'Work in progress'+description+'Bookings open soon'; 3 Barsaat cards show ₹2,500/₹2,800 and working Reserve button. Admin Registrations tab: all 6 direct registrations have data-testid='send-confirmation-<id>' button, the OFF-SITE Aggregator Guest row does NOT. Live email send to reachbiraajo@gmail.com returned 200 {ok:true,sent_to}; send to @example.com correctly returned 502 with 'Email could not be sent' detail (Resend onboarding domain limitation, expected).
critical_code_review_comments: send_registration_confirmation endpoint does NOT gate on payment_status — an admin can 'confirm' a still-pending guest and send a confirmation email. Consider guarding with `if reg.get('payment_status') != 'confirmed': raise 400` or at minimum surfacing the pending status to the admin dialog.
test_barsaat_still_bookable has a stray `return reg_id` triggering PytestReturnNotNoneWarning — cosmetic, fixed for next run recommended (replace with plain assignment).
AdminDashboard.jsx still >1100 lines (carried from prior iterations).
Resend hard-coded sender onboarding@resend.dev — verify custom domain before launch so confirmation email actually reaches non-owner guests.
seed_data_creation: Test created transient direct registrations on Barsaat First Table (TEST_ConfirmRecipient reachbiraajo@gmail.com, TEST_ConfirmRecipient test_conf_*@example.com, TEST_BarsaatSmoke). All deleted post-test. 4 Yaadein events + 3 Barsaat events + demo registrations untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints: POST /api/registrations/{id}/send-confirmation (admin) → 200 ok / 502 email-err / 404 unknown / 401 unauth. Response persists confirmation_email_sent + confirmation_email_sent_at. Registration model requires event_id in body when POSTing to /api/events/{id}/register. Coming-soon events (Yaadein) return HTTP 403 'Bookings for this series aren't open yet.' on register. GET /api/gallery sorted created_at DESC. Frontend testids added: event-wip-button, wip-modal, wip-close, send-confirmation-<regId>. Off-site rows use OffsiteBooking collection at /api/admin/offsite-bookings (note admin prefix).
rca of the issue: No live issues. All three requested features (A/B/C) work as spec'd; both Resend delivery paths (owner-success and guest-failure-502) behave per Resend sandbox limitation.
